description.value: Cilantro UWS is a casual Mexican restaurant at 485 Columbus Ave, New York, NY 10024. Its Uber Eats store lists Mexican • Tacos • Burritos as the main categories. It is a relaxed neighborhood choice near the American Museum of Natural History.
